faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Trichy Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the NIT Trichy Project Staff recruitment is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: For JRF, a B.E/B.Tech with First class in Electrical Engineering or equivalent and a valid GATE score is required. For Project Associate, a B.E/B.Tech with First class in Electrical Engineering or equivalent is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 32 years. Age relaxations are provided for SC/ST (5 years) and OBC (3 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Project Staff positions at NIT Trichy?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their duly filled applications along with supporting documents via email to [email protected] and [email protected] as a single PDF document.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF and Project Associate positions?
faq.answer: For JRF, the salary is Rs. 37,000 + HRA (1st-2nd year) and Rs. 42,000 + HRA (3rd year). For Project Associate - I, it's Rs. 30,000 + HRA (1st-2nd year) and Rs. 33,000 + HRA (3rd year).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Staff roles?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a screening test followed by an interview for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Staff position (Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate - I).

faq.question: Q9. Which email addresses should I use to submit my application?
faq.answer: You should send your application to both [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to fill out a Google Form in addition to the email application?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants are also requested to fill out the Google Form attached in the application instructions, the link for which is provided in the 'How to Apply' section.
